verdict.rationale: Carta docs describe an official Claude/MCP integration allowing natural-language queries against cap table, stakeholder, SAFE, option grant, and fund data (carta-docs-9, carta-docs-10, carta-docs-11), which directly supports AI-native natural-language operation. However, this is scoped to specific plugins/data domains rather than the full product surface, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP experience actually working well. missing for 10: broader coverage beyond cap-table/investor plugins, independent verification of natural-language command reliability, and evidence of NL support outside the MCP/Claude integration.
